concepts: Hands in close-up plugging a USB adapter into a networked PLC mounted on a factory wall, soft focus on the production floor behind, morning light from a high window.

A technician's fingers typing at a keyboard beside a dual-monitor setup displaying system diagnostics, shallow depth of field, the manufacturing floor visible as a blur through the office glass wall behind.
Tight shot of hands holding a handheld scanner aimed at a networked shop-floor device, shallow focus, the machine's control panel softly out of focus in the background.

Wide shot of a modern finance floor at golden hour, two figures at separate desks across the space—one reviewing screens, the other at a tablet cross-referencing data—afternoon light casting long shadows across the open plan.

A large wall-mounted display showing forecast dashboards (text unreadable) in soft focus, three figures standing at distance below it in discussion, the entire control room visible behind, cool ambient lighting.

Finance floor from an elevated angle, an audit table in the foreground with two figures reviewing printed reports side-by-side, the broader workspace and other workstations receding behind them, window light from the left.
